# Red Ackee Software - Code Contribution Guidelines

In each repository, consider app format consistency, project structure, and coding standards. <!-- Below are guidelines to follow:  -->

Consider the overall security best practices, performance optimizations, and maintainability of the codebase.

Evaluate code for accessibility compliance, especially for web applications.

Ask about unit tests, integration tests, or end-to-end tests if relevant to the code changes.

When generating code snippets, ensure they align with the existing coding style and conventions used in the project. Make sure new changes are tested and do not introduce regressions.

Give scores from 1-10 on code quality, maintainability, security, regression status and adherence to best practices.
